headline.text: Five standups, then a flight to Sydney. The 2 to 4 block is the only real room you get, so spend it on the feature-flag call that has Renner stopped.

acts.text: Five standups back to back from 11:30, with the GiftCard Report kick-off wedged in at 1. You are the organiser of the Insights one only.
Two hours of protected focus, the only unbroken stretch this week. Three of the five Decide items fit here.
Product Discovery, then UK pub strategy with Adrian and Callum's group, then VA883 at 7. Nothing lands after 5:30.

items.title: Feature flag logic for the inventory V2 screen
items.question: Show the old product view when inventory is disabled, and the new V2 screen when enabled?
items.why: Old product view when inventory is off, new V2 screen when on. Raised in the Inventory standup, 27 Jul, and Renner has been stopped on it since.

items.title: Guest versus Customer: are the persona definitions right
items.question: Confirm the Guest and Customer definitions, and whether a unique cross-org profile is in scope for September.
items.why: Marlow asked in a DM at 18:02 yesterday and flagged that a unique cross-org profile cannot land by end of September. The answer sets September scope, not just naming.

items.title: PAPP-903 variant selection modal redesign
items.question: What is the modal design that fixes child variant display without breaking layout assignment?
items.why: You own the rethink. Assigned in the Products App standup, 28 Jul. Still To Do, and it was due 6 July.

items.title: When to slot the Northwind mapping endpoint
items.question: Does the two-day mapping endpoint go in now, or does the manual store ID workaround hold?
items.why: Roughly two days of work, and the manual store ID workaround holds until then. Left open in the Northwind Warehouse session, 28 Jul as capacity dependent, which means it waits on you.
items.evidence: Granola, Northwind data ingestion session, 28 Jul

items.title: Online store name overrides breaking Insights reporting
items.question: Do name overrides get removed, mapped, or excluded from reporting before the settings migration?
items.why: Overrides are corrupting product-level reporting. Flagged as needing a Products team discussion before the settings migration starts in the second week of August.
items.evidence: Granola, Products App settings UI session, 27 Jul

items.title: Adrian: should Bram be in the Baymont demo
items.question: Niel, should we have someone like Bram in the meeting too?
items.why: Delcourt proposed the slot, Adrian locked it in and put the question straight to you by email at 11:39 yesterday. The demo cannot be finalised until you answer.
items.evidence: Email, Re: Baymont Demo request, 28 Jul

items.title: Petra's rename on the Oolio Office board
items.question: Rename the field to something that encompasses both Purchase and the other case.
items.why: "This should be renamed to something which encompasses both Purchase or…" He @-mentioned you in Figma yesterday, then added five more comments on the same board.

items.title: Trello versus Asana gap analysis
items.question: Did the gap analysis land, or did it slip?
items.why: Was due midday Monday. No confirmation in any source since, so either it landed silently or it slipped. Worth thirty seconds to close.

items.title: Wren's payable and net receivable question
items.question: Store A need to pay for which store?
items.why: "Store A need to pay for which store?" Asked in a DM yesterday afternoon against Ivo's Figma, and the thread stops there.

items.title: Menus release goes out tonight
items.why: Targeted for today after the pots release yesterday. Confirmed in the menus and mPOS testing session, and it carries a combos DB migration where in-flight menu edits are lost.
items.evidence: Granola, Menus and mPOS testing, 27 Jul

items.title: OR-4101 Table Service Operational Insights
items.why: Epic, still in Scoping, due Friday, priority Highest. Jira, updated 27 Jul. Three days to move it out of Scoping or move the date.

items.title: INC-518 Grainhouse products not reaching Oolio Orders or QuickDash
items.why: Trade Degraded, sitting in Test-in Testing. Jira, updated 27 Jul. A live customer is affected while it waits for a test pass.

items.title: OR-4102 Repeat Guest Insights
items.why: Due 30 June, still Scoping, priority High, but updated yesterday, so it is live work with a dead date rather than an abandoned ticket. Re-date it or drop it.

items.title: PAPP-903 variant layout bug
items.why: Due 6 July, still To Do, and it is the same ticket as Decide #3. Jira, updated yesterday. It is late because it is waiting on your design call.

groups.label: Incidents
groups.text: Fernway twice, The Yard price list sync, Grainhouse meal deal printing, Calvetti product deletion, Attic Bar discounts, KDS duplicates, Aurora Group Tablebird. The heaviest incident week since June.

groups.label: Products App
groups.text: Advanced product export, modifier attribute alignment, misc option group pricing, allergens now syncing into OOM. PAPP-900, the dependencies and defects epic, closed.

groups.label: Kiosk
groups.text: Modifiers integrated on price lists, and the combo upgrade prompt is live in the self-service flow.

groups.label: Insights
groups.text: Filter by venue and store shipped. Quiet week on delivery while the Warehouse ingestion work runs upstream.

groups.label: Cancelled
groups.text: Four Products App stories cancelled including the CDS combo upgrade display and the required-options auto-advance. Worth a glance in case any were load-bearing.

groups.label: Inventory
groups.text: Nothing closed in three days. Consistent with the team waiting on the feature flag decision above.

items.title: Reporting philosophy settled: product name at time of transaction
items.why: The team chose to fix Uber-side naming rather than move to ID-based reporting. Decided in the Northwind Warehouse session. This is a durable call and belongs in 41 Decisions.
items.evidence: Granola, Northwind data ingestion session, 28 Jul

items.title: Historical data routes to its own S3 bucket
items.why: Anything older than a month leaves the live transaction queue, and enrichment data is embedded directly in the payload rather than inheriting Ledger's gaps. Same session.
items.evidence: Granola, Northwind data ingestion session, 28 Jul

items.title: Action log retention priced as an enterprise lever
items.why: 30 days live, archive to 12 months, extended retention chargeable. Settled in the Salt & Anchor rollout session. That is a commercial decision made inside a delivery meeting.
items.evidence: Granola, Salt & Anchor rollout session, 26 Jul

items.title: Accounts releases now land by Wednesday
items.why: The accounts team set a standing rule because so many applications depend on Accounts, Locations and Business. Posted in #dev on Friday, and it affects every downstream release plan you hold.

trajectory.statement: The three things that actually matter this week
Settings migration starts in the second week of August
trajectory.note: Verbal commitment, 27 Jul. No ticket yet.

trajectory.statement: Three shipping initiatives in Delivery: Reservations Phase 1, Guest Waitlist, Feedback App
trajectory.note: 3 of 5 initiatives in Delivery, 2 still Proposed

trajectory.statement: Insights reaches weekly active use across venues
trajectory.note: No target set. PostHog project 24110 ready to wire.

trajectory.statement: Oolio One is a platform, and the data and AI advantage is undeniable
trajectory.note: Mission is set. No measurable end state yet.
